Hints: This information can be used by a code generator to create the correct signa- ture. In case this method is applied to generate C-style enums it should be avoided to use the same CompuMethod as input to a generator (for example the RTE genera- tor) that produces preprocessor literals instead. Otherwise, the enum-literals and the preprocessor-literals might get in conflict.
